title: NNSA rate hold: a 100-pit 2028 objective is not recurring accepted output
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy and National Nuclear Security Administration
summary: DOE-NNSA testimony states an objective to produce at least 100 pits by the end of calendar 2028, reach 30 pits per year, and expand LANL target capacity beyond 60 pits per year, but it does not disclose additional qualified W87-1 output. Denominator: The forward LANL production and capacity objectives in May 2026 testimony, kept separate from the single qualified W87-1 First Production Unit and any observed recurring period.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Rate, capacity, and baseline hold.

Finding: DOE-NNSA testimony states an objective to produce at least 100 pits by the end of calendar 2028, reach 30 pits per year, and expand LANL target capacity beyond 60 pits per year, but it does not disclose additional qualified W87-1 output.
Denominator: The forward LANL production and capacity objectives in May 2026 testimony, kept separate from the single qualified W87-1 First Production Unit and any observed recurring period.
Boundary: A target count and capacity objective are not actual qualified production.
Boundary: The testimony does not disclose accepted pits after the first production unit.
Boundary: No rejects, rework, equipment attribution, recurring rate, schedule confidence, lifecycle cost, or enterprise readiness result is reported.
Next action: Reopen with a defined period, qualified and accepted pit count, rejects and rework, equipment attribution, rate, capacity acceptance, schedule, lifecycle cost, and independent review.
why_it_matters: The visible hold preserves a useful reporting, schedule, capacity, performance, or baseline boundary without presenting it as an accepted result.
